title: SetGroupingRequest
description: Asks for the stored analysis of one repository to be projected in the other grouping. It spends nothing: both groupings were produced by the run that is already paid for, and this call reads one of them out. The chosen grouping is remembered against that analysis, and becomes the one a new analysis opens in.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path of the worktree root, as repository.open returned it.

grouping.title: SetGroupingMode
grouping.description: The grouping to switch to. The same values as AnalysisGroupingMode in analysis-view.schema.json, duplicated because a schema here cannot reference one there, and held to it by AnalysisAgreementTests. Asking for one the stored analysis does not hold is refused rather than silently ignored.
